BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE course_planning_input_checkpoint,course_planning_generated_checkpoint,course_planning_ensure_checkpoint IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM course_planning_input_checkpoint) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM course_planning_generated_checkpoint) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM course_planning_ensure_checkpoint) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot discard retained planning checkpoints';
 END IF;
END $$;
DROP TABLE course_planning_ensure_checkpoint;
DROP TABLE course_planning_generated_checkpoint;
DROP TABLE course_planning_input_checkpoint;
DROP FUNCTION guard_course_planning_checkpoint_insert();
DROP FUNCTION protect_course_planning_checkpoint();
COMMIT;
